first.rationale: I intend to test a focused onboarding simplification because both completion and activation are currently declining, and prior evidence indicates this intervention improves time-to-value and first-week activation. I would verify both archived records before committing, while guarding against faster completion that does not translate into qualified downstream value. Promotional pricing may counter competitor pressure, but it risks lower-quality or less sustainable revenue and does not directly address the activation and onboarding deterioration.
